# Requirements Quality Checklist

## Requirement ID Coverage
- [x] All requirements use REQ-XXX format
- [x] IDs are unique and sequential

## Testability
- [x] Every requirement is independently testable
- [x] Acceptance criteria use Given-When-Then statements

## Completeness
- [x] Scope Baseline section is complete
- [x] User Scenarios are prioritized P1/P2
- [x] Functional requirements cover all redesign items
- [x] Success criteria are measurable

## Constitution Alignment
- [ ] Constitution document unavailable at task start
- [x] Migration mode: in-place redesign, no unrelated cleanup
- [x] Existing platform behavior preserved

## Preservation Coverage
- [x] Authentication and authorization
- [x] Purchase/entitlement access
- [x] Module and topic versioning
- [x] Provider abstraction and configuration
- [x] Secure Java code execution

## Redesign Coverage
- [x] Simplified topic authoring
- [x] AI curriculum preview and explicit approval
- [x] Persistent unified tutor conversation
- [x] Backend-authoritative stages
- [x] Safe idempotency
- [x] Objective evidence and mastery
- [x] Adaptive question-first teaching
- [x] Progressive non-leaking hints

## Readiness
- [x] Ready for architect, UX, DBA, backend, frontend, and tester decomposition
